title: Shining Strand
wikitext:
[[image:Shining_Strand.jpg|thumb|The Shining Strand]]
'''The Shining Strand''' is the name of the section of shoreline of [[Lordamere Lake]] in [[Silverpine Forest]]. It stretches from the Lordaeron capital city in the north and ends at the range of rough hills that divides Silverpine from the [[Alterac Mountains]]. 

The [[Vile Fin]] tribe of [[murlocs]] has several settlements along the Strand making it very dangerous for unseasoned travellers. In his journal, the late [[Apothecary Berard]] spoke of a rare item that could be obtained from the Vile Fins, a Hardened Tumor. Berard speculated that the tumor could be used in the concoction of a new plague.
